name: Nazo no Seinen
source:
Only when he sees that you're close to a certain somebody in the story, will Nazo no Seinen make an appearance. He is naive, innocent and cheerful with a bright and carefree personality. Where he lives, what he does and his identity is a mystery.

[Spoiler]Nazo no Seinen is actually the "true" form of the Seven Dwarves when they remerge as one. Because of Nazo no Seinen's more adult appearance, Tiana nicknames him "Otona-san", which translates to "Mr. Adult". 

While he doesn't have a route, when a certain ending is obtained, as a bonus, you get his "Secret Memo". His real name is Anel and he is 25-years-old. His favourite food is sweets, favourite colour is the seven colours of the rainbow and his hobby is to collect beetles, specifically, [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhinoceros_beetle]Rhinoceros beetles.[/URL][/Spoiler]

[Taken from the [url=http://calameliatorte.com/character_grown.php]official website[/url]]
